page: Microsoft Azure E64ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The system includes 512.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It is equipped with 3780 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable. The processor architecture is x86_64, featuring a 480 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64ds_v7 demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities and high memory throughput. The PassMark CPU score is in the top tier at 89771.17, supported by strong multi-core stress-ng performance of 73052.88. Memory bandwidth is robust, reaching 332.26 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 128.16 GB/sec for write operations. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression perform in the top tier, registering 36.25 GB/sec and 14.98 GB/sec respectively. Database operations are highly efficient, with PassMark database operations scoring in the top tier at 33062.35 and Redis SET operations processing 117.01 million operations per second.

The server exhibits strong performance in large language model inference tasks. For prompt processing, it achieves top-tier speeds of 4079.59 tokens per second on a small 135M model and 39.93 tokens per second on a large 70B model. Text generation speeds are more moderate, averaging 214.23 tokens per second for the 135M model and 4.31 tokens per second for the 70B model. Given the high vCPU-to-RAM ratio, high-capacity local storage, and strong database benchmarks, this instance is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, and enterprise-grade web serving.
